meta.scope: Correct S037 per-dataset denominators and reported performance dispersion

records.title: A CrossMod-Transformer deep learning framework for multi-modal pain detection through EDA and ECG fusion

decisions.notes: BioVid uses extreme heat-pain classes and AI4Pain uses a different cardiac modality and hold-out scheme. Cross-dataset use is not evidence for chronic pain, ECAP, or SCS outcomes. Full publisher text rechecked 2026-09-28: BioVid and AI4PAIN denominators are 87 and 65, not a pooled sample. F1 distributions across folds/subjects are shown in Fig. 4 and the article describes confidence intervals and SD; this is performance dispersion, not predictive uncertainty or calibration. Optuna tuning used 10-fold BioVid CV before both reported evaluation schemes; a nested subject-disjoint tuning procedure is not established, so performance may be optimistic.
